snippet.title: The Maze Survivor: 9th Entrants – Updated Gameplay Overview
snippet.description:
If you like Maze Runner, SCP, The Backrooms, survival sandbox games, or chaotic multiplayer horror—don’t miss this indie game I’ve been developing solo for 2 years:

🕳️The Maze Survivor: The 9th Entrants

🎮Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2812670/_/

🗓️ Launching July 14!
